4264-4808-4812-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Altered Ego by paying {2}{G}{U}, causing it to enter as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

751-4289-5434.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4210-4279-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4210-4279-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

147-2511-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-2511-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Generous Revival.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

5702-8097.easyPrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
5702-8097.notablePrerequisites: At least half of the basic land cards in your library are Forests.
5702-8097.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Avatar of Growth.
When the Avatar of Growth token enters, it triggers, causing each player to search their library for up to two basic land cards and put them onto the battefield. Search for a Forest and any other basic land.
When the basic lands enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Avatar of Growth
Repeat from step 3 until your library contains no basic lands.
5702-8097.notes: You can perform this combo if fewer than half the basic lands in your library are Forests, but in that case you won't be able to find all your basic lands unless you pay an additional {G} per additional pair of non-Forest lands once you run out of Forests.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

5551-5552-6495.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
5551-5552-6495.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat from step 4.
5551-5552-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1379-1978-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Halflings.

101-3617-7370.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Vampire Charmseeker.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Vampire Charmseeker from exile to the battlefield.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1927-3652-3661-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1927-3652-3661-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6146-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6146-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6146-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1308-4659-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-4659-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3033-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3033-6797-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

3490-4050-7430.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
Gorma triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

891-2730-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4871-7072-7296.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

1912-2018-4050-7216.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter, adding {W}.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Moonlit Lamenter from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a flying counter on it.
Activate Moonlit Lamenter by paying {W} and removing the flying counter from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

141-554-2921.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-554-2921.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

618-2034-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

38-5220-6794-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1987-3139-4316-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Great Henge by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Cast Ghostly Flicker from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Great Henge.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

345-5641-5662.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to Metallic Mimic.
When Basking Broodscale enters, it triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Metallic Mimic.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Metallic Mimic.
Repeat from step 3.

2043-4050-4772-5446.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.
2043-4050-4772-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

4929-5224-6602.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Together Forever, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1171-3480.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-3480.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

2178-2857-5686.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Adarkar Valkyrie.
2178-2857-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
2178-2857-5686.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another creature you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Resolve the second trigger, returning the sacrificed creature to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

338-2060-3490-3910-4772.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
338-2060-3490-3910-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
338-2060-3490-3910-4772.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting ten +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

4094-4770-5554.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
4094-4770-5554.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double all tokens you create this turn.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat from step 2.

1734-4344-4598-4605.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Fiend Hunter until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning any cards exiled with it to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a copy of Lumbering Battlement that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Lumbering Battlement until the token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
The nontoken Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, choose not to exile a creature.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling the token Lumbering Battlement.
The token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Lumbering Battlement from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3974-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Rogue, Cleric, Wizard and/or Warrior that can be cast using one colored mana.
3974-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any nontoken Rogue, Cleric, Wizard and/or Warrior that can be cast using one colored mana, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Mortuary, putting the creature on top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3489-3752-3987.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3489-3752-3987.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
When the creature is unblocked, activate Phage's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning the unblocked creature to your hand, putting Phage onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Phage enters the battlefield, however its ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Deal combat damage with Phage.
Phage triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

337-776-1329-1886.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-776-1329-1886.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Jeweled Amulet to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Jeweled Amulet.
Cast Jeweled Amulet.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
